correctness.rationale: From the actual RESULT.md and verify.py Git blobs: 45 explicit coefficient triples over F9 specialize to the conic secant set, verified by finite exact projective enumeration as a specified exhaustive algebraic identity. Conic geometry has ten 9-fold points, 45 external 4-fold and 36 internal 5-fold points, and 990 counted pairs. Frobenius fixes nine lines and 13 F3 points, with incidence correction 23; formulas D(F_(3^n))=9q−14 for odd n and 45q−314 for even n imply U counts and rational zetas. Independently enumerated 91 F9 points and ten conic points. Crucial risk is transcription of all 45 source forms; Harbourne Example 3.3.4 was checked in original PDF.
